name: The Assembly
vanishCauses: walked into the lower training wing and the door sealed behind them.
was called to the Sub-Levels for "a short assessment". Nobody has seen them since.
took the service lift down after midnight. The lift came back empty.
was last seen on a corridor camera, walking toward a door that isn't on the floor plan.
stayed behind after a closed-door drill. The arena lights went off with them still inside.
received a sealed envelope at breakfast and left the Wing without finishing their tea.
returnTexts: came back up from the Sub-Levels. They won't say what's down there.
walked out of the service lift at dawn, in a kit nobody issued.
was found asleep in the Glass Box, boots still laced. Something has changed.

playerMods.name: Night Shift
playerMods.description: Trains when the floodlights are off. +6 vision, −4 stamina.

playerMods.name: Static Charge
playerMods.description: The ball sticks to them. +8 first touch, −4 aerial.

playerMods.name: Frostbitten
playerMods.description: Spent too long in the Cold Room. −6 pace.

playerMods.name: Echoed
playerMods.description: Came back from the Sub-Levels. +5 to everything that matters.

playerMods.name: Hollow-Eyed
playerMods.description: Came back from the Sub-Levels. +10 finishing, −8 composure.

events.text: {player} has been issued new boots by the facility. They are made of something clear.
{player} hasn't slept since the scrimmage. They say they feel incredible.
Dorm cameras show {player} training alone at 3 a.m. Again.
{player} touched an arena wall during a storm drill. The ball now follows them.
{player} was locked in the Cold Room overnight. "Administrative error," says the Director.
{player} keeps getting stuck to the steel walls. Opponents are getting stuck to {player}.
{player} opened a door marked DO NOT OPEN. Every first touch since has gone wrong.
{player} found a note under their pillow: YOU ARE DOING WELL. Their game has never been better.

facilityEvents.name: Lights Out
facilityEvents.text: Director: Lights Out in effect. Five minutes. Good luck.

facilityEvents.name: Ball Swap
facilityEvents.text: Director: A heavier ball has been introduced. Adjust accordingly.

facilityEvents.name: Sealed Door
facilityEvents.text: Director: One arena door failed to open this morning. {player} will watch from the corridor.

facilityEvents.name: Wall Shift
facilityEvents.text: Director: A wall panel has moved inward. The arena is smaller. Please continue.

facilityEvents.name: The Drill
facilityEvents.text: Director: A surprise skill test was held before kickoff. {team} won it.

facilityEvents.name: Weather Simulation: Fog
facilityEvents.text: Director: Weather Simulation active. Fog. Visibility is not our concern.

facilityEvents.name: Weather Simulation: Wind Tunnel
facilityEvents.text: Director: Wind Tunnel engaged. Long balls are now a matter of faith.

facilityEvents.name: Weather Simulation: Heat Chamber
facilityEvents.text: Director: Heat Chamber active. Hydration is permitted.

facilityEvents.name: Weather Simulation: Rain
facilityEvents.text: Director: Artificial rain scheduled for the duration of the match.
